project.name: my-hw-bot
project.description: A production Python pipeline that collects Hot Wheels news, filters and deduplicates articles, transcreates accepted items into Russian, publishes them on schedule, and is being completed with the approved reliability, observability, dashboard, provider, and source roadmap.

tasks.title: Sanitize legacy dedup decision log identifiers

Reuse the existing bounded identifier/source sanitizers and add only focused regression assertions without changing dedup decisions, Telegram alerts, or rate limiting.
